description:
Add rustdoc to the filter algebra types in crate-jmap-mail-types documenting their exclusion from the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy "Decision: filter algebra excluded", 2026-05-10).

## Types in scope

`crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs`:
- `EmailFilterCondition` (line 54)
- `EmailComparator` (line 232)
- `ComparatorProperty` (line 171)

## Required rustdoc content

Same template as the canonical foundation (child .1 of this epic), adapted to the mail-types FilterCondition / Comparator idiom. Each type gets a doc comment covering:

1. **Exclusion notice** — OUT of scope for the workspace extras-preservation policy.
2. **Rationale** — same three reasons (silent-drop foot-gun, untagged-dispatch incompatibility, control-enum dispatch).
3. **Future hook — IETF-track path**: `draft-ietf-jmap-metadata` (capability URI `urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata`) — companion Annotation objects with capability-declared schema and `Metadata/query` `textMatch` filter. Workspace tracker: JMAP-06zp.
4. **Future hook — pre-IETF escape**: sloppy-value escape via `serde_json::Value` or fork `EmailFilterCondition`. See `crate-jmap-calendars-types/PLAN.md` for the hybrid sloppy-value pattern.
5. **Cross-reference** — link/reference to JMAP-lbdy.

## Cookie-cutter consistency

This is the **canonical extension-types template** per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates". Wording chosen here propagates to all six sibling extension-types crates (chat, calendars, contacts, tasks, filenode, sharing) in the same pass or with a follow-up sweep bead before merging. chat-types has no filter algebra and is exempt.

## Acceptance criteria

- All three types (`EmailFilterCondition`, `EmailComparator`, `ComparatorProperty`) carry the exclusion notice with both future-hook paths.
- `cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-mail-types --all-features` clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-mail-types --all-features -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo test -p jmap-mail-types --all-features` clean.

No code changes beyond doc comments. No public API additions or removals.
title: Add filter-algebra exclusion rustdoc to jmap-mail-types (canonical extension template)
